audit: 2026-11-19, by reading each card's rules text (python/spellbench/human/manabrew/cards.json) and the engine's implementation note (mtg-kernel engine.rs, RuntimeRulesV1). A card is a reader when its rules or this engine's implementation of it depend on the order of cards in a graveyard. A card that joins a deck pool is read and added to one of the two lists below before it is played; the test integrations/mtg_kernel/london_human/tests/test_graveyard_order_v1.py fails until it is (it also checks that the catalog the engine reads holds the client's decks card for card).

readers.Gurmag Angler: Delve: this engine exiles the oldest graveyard cards first (mana::delve_payment_plan), and it refuses its graveyard rule for a game with a Delve card. In no deck of the eight-deck pool.

not_readers.Balustrade Spy: mills a target player until a land; no order read
not_readers.Dread Return: returns a chosen creature card; flashback
not_readers.Eviscerator's Insight: draws two; flashback from the graveyard (sacrifice an artifact or creature as a cost)
not_readers.Ichor Wellspring: draws when it goes to the graveyard
not_readers.Lembas: shuffled into the library from the graveyard
not_readers.Lotleth Giant: counts creature cards in a graveyard
not_readers.Masked Vandal: may exile a chosen creature card from your own graveyard
not_readers.Prismatic Strands: flashback by tapping a white creature
not_readers.Pulse of Murasa: returns a chosen creature or land card
not_readers.Sneaky Snacker: returns from the graveyard on a third draw
not_readers.Thraben Charm: exiles all cards from a graveyard
not_readers.Winding Way: reveals the top cards; the rest go to the graveyard
